description: In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), create a manual journal entry to record an office rent expense. Navigate to Journal Entries and click 'New Journal Entry'. Set the date to today and enter the following two lines: Line 1 — Account: Accounting fees (or any available expense account such as 'Advertising and promotion'), Debit: 3000.00; Line 2 — Account: Retained earnings (equity account), Credit: 3000.00. Add a narration/description: 'Prepaid office rent Q1'. Ensure debits equal credits (both 3000.00) and save the entry. Credentials: Username = administrator, Password = (leave empty).
